table.role: Single implementation language for the MCP server and Brain proxy.
Core MCP server exposing QI ecosystem tools (Brain, registry, health) over Streamable HTTP.
Hosts the FastMCP ASGI app plus AuthGate wrapper and /health /version /info contract endpoints.
Proxies tool calls to QI Brain (localhost:9011) with graceful fallback when Brain is offline.
Doc generation utility for session summaries.
Runs the connector as a Windows service (C:\QIH\engine\bin\nssm.exe).
Publishes connector.quiddityinnovations.com to claude.ai / Claude Code.
Capability-URL auth for claude.ai + bearer tokens for Claude Code (AuthGate).

descriptions.title: Stack
descriptions.body: Remote MCP connector for Claude. Single service on 127.0.0.1:9030 behind a named Cloudflare tunnel (connector.quiddityinnovations.com). No UI port — the former Gradio ui/ scaffold (stale ports 8507/7847) was removed 2026-08-02.
